title: Strieber's career destroyed, which he ties to the Collins Elite

tellings.quote: if you look at Beyond and the episode three and you see what happened to me and what it did to my life and it's got something to do with them. I'm convinced.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who has written about his own encounters with beings he calls visitors, says his career and life were wrecked from the late 1980s on, and he is "convinced" it has "something to do with" a secretive group known as the Collins Elite. He tells it as his own life and points to the third episode of Beyond, a series made by the film studio MGM, as showing "what happened to me and what it did to my life," which, if he is right, would mean someone set out to ruin him for what he said.
